cpu_governor.description: CPU frequency scaling governor to use when gamemode is active (e.g., performance, schedutil, powersave).

gpu_governor.description: GPU frequency scaling governor to use when gamemode is active (if supported by hardware).

idle_time.description: Number of seconds to wait after a game exits before restoring original settings.

exclude_processes.description: List of process name patterns to exclude from gamemode (supports glob patterns like '*steam*').

pattern.description: Shell-style glob pattern to match process names (e.g., 'steamwebhelper', '*minecraft*').

scripts.description: List of custom scripts to run during gamemode lifecycle events.

event.description: When to run the script: 'enter' when entering gamemode, 'exit' when exiting.

path.description: Absolute path to the script file (must be executable).

gpu_boost.description: Enable GPU boost (if hardware/driver supports it).

max_concurrent_games.description: Maximum number of concurrent game sessions allowed.

log_file.description: Path to the gamemode log file.

nice.description: Adjust process nice priority for games.

enabled.description: Enable nice priority adjustment for game processes.

value.description: Nice value to apply (range: -20 to 19; higher value = lower priority).

io.description: Adjust I/O scheduling for game processes.

enabled.description: Enable I/O priority adjustment for game processes.

priority.description: I/O priority level (0-7; only used with best-effort class; higher = lower priority).

renice.description: Adjust process priority via renice (legacy alias; prefer 'nice' setting).

enabled.description: Enable renice priority adjustment (negative values increase priority).

value.description: Renice value to apply (range: -20 to 19; negative = higher priority).

reset_fpu.description: Reset FPU state on gamemode entry (recommended for Intel CPUs to prevent floating-point inconsistencies).
